subject: Marketplace joint demo — APAC time corridor conflict & fallback plan
messages:
From: Emma Thorpe <emma.thorpe@bluecascade.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: partners_ops@aws-marketplace.com
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 17:12:00 +10:00
Subject: Re: Joint marketplace demo — Thursday (APAC) — short notice ask

Hi team,

Quick heads up — the AWS SI on our side (lead infra reviewer) flagged a mandatory preflight that runs only on Thursday morning SGT. They just confirmed we can't proceed with the walkthrough unless the audit intake completes.

We know Redwood and AWS teams worked hard on the runbook; sorry to surface this late. Can we either:
- push the joint demo to Friday 09:00–10:30 SGT, or
- keep Thursday but run only the product showcase (no infra deep dive) and schedule the infra replay next week.

I attached the runbook and the AWS preflight checklist so you can see the blocker.

Appreciate a quick call if helpful — Emma

--
Emma Thorpe
Product Partnerships, BlueCascade Systems
emma.thorpe@bluecascade.com | +65 8123 4455

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Emma Thorpe <emma.thorpe@bluecascade.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 18:03:00 +10:00
Subject: Re: Joint marketplace demo — APAC time corridor conflict & fallback plan

Emma — thanks for the flag and the checklist.

Immediate thoughts:
- I'm fine moving to Friday 09:00–10:30 SGT if that keeps all reviewers in the room.
- If AWS absolutely needs the Thursday morning slot for preflight, we can run the product demo Thursday 15:00 UTC (23:00 SGT) as a condensed public-facing session and then a separate infra session for SI reviewers on Friday.

Vanessa / Kim / Karthik — can you confirm availability for:
A) Friday 2026-05-08 09:00–10:30 SGT (22:00–23:30 UTC Thu 7 May) — full demo + infra
B) Thursday 2026-05-07 23:00–23:30 SGT — condensed public demo only (no infra), infra replay Fri morning

If we go with option A we should update the HubSpot opportunity (HS-998234) and push the recording link to the partner folder.

Sean

--
Sean Gallagher
Sr. Partner Sales | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 18:28:00 +10:00
Subject: Re: Joint marketplace demo — APAC time corridor conflict & fallback plan

Sean — FYI I checked calendars.

- I'm green for Friday 09:00–10:30 SGT (A).
- I can do the condensed Thursday 23:00 SGT (B) but would prefer A to ensure CS and Solutions Engineering can present the end-to-end value props.

If we choose A, I recommend we:
1) Send a short email to the customer-facing list confirming Friday and include an agenda with clear ask items (what we want them to validate).
2) Reserve a 30-min pre-call with BlueCascade’s infra leads on Thursday afternoon (their local time) to walk the preflight checklist — that will reduce Friday friction.

I'll update the calendar hold tentatively for Friday and attach a proposed agenda.

Vanessa

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Attachment: proposed_agenda_friday.docx (see Drive link)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Emma Thorpe <emma.thorpe@bluecascade.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 19:05:00 +10:00
Subject: Re: Joint marketplace demo — APAC time corridor conflict & fallback plan

Thanks Emma & team. Quick availability check from Solutions Eng:
- A) Friday 08 May 09:00–10:30 SGT — Joel (SE) and I are good. We'll prepare the infra replay deck and the short run-through of the deployment template.
- B) Condensed Thursday session — Joel can only join if it's before midnight SGT, so 23:00 is tight but possible.

Action items I can own:
- Prepare a 20-min infra replay slide deck (attach as PDF)
- Draft the Friday agenda and the ask list for BlueCascade (Who signs off on infra check?)

Emma — can you confirm whether the AWS reviewer needs access to any private test accounts ahead of the preflight? If so, we should request IAM access and include that in the preflight checklist.

Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
Attachment: infra_replay_v1.pdf

From: Emma Thorpe <emma.thorpe@bluecascade.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 16:45:00 +10:00
Subject: Re: Joint marketplace demo — APAC time corridor conflict & fallback plan

All — thanks for the quick responses.

We prefer option A (Friday 09:00–10:30 SGT) to keep the SI reviewers and marketplace listing folks together.

To Kimberly's question: yes, they need read-only IAM to the sandbox account and temporary access to our test listing on AWS Marketplace. I'll open the request now (CCing partners_ops@aws-marketplace.com).

I'll also confirm the AWS preflight completion ETA — expect it by Thursday 23:59 SGT. If it slips, we'll fallback to the condensed Thursday public demo option.

I'll update HS-998234 and drop the updated agenda in the Drive folder. Thanks — Emma

--
Emma Thorpe
Product Partnerships, BlueCascade Systems
